dict.title: Web search and fetch
dict.description: Choose the providers web search and web fetch use.
dict.legacyKeyHint: Uses the signed-in account on account-model requests; otherwise uses this API key ({ref}), shared with Models by default.
dict.maxUsesHint: Maximum server-side searches per Messages request: a positive integer, default 5.
dict.invalidMaxUses: Enter a positive integer, or leave blank to use the default.
dict.searchAutoHint: Follows the conversation's model: DeepSeek models use DeepSeek server-side search, which has no per-search charge; other models use DeepSeek Search API.
dict.providersFailed: Couldn't load the provider list, so this menu may be incomplete.
dict.pluginProviderHint: Configure this provider in its own plugin settings.
dict.baseUrlHint: Include the API prefix. Leave blank to use the official address. The provider appends {path}.
dict.countHint: Results returned per search: 1 to 50, default 10.
dict.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
dict.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
dict.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
dict.invalidCount: Enter an integer from 1 to 50, or leave blank to use the default.
dict.billingAutoHint: Follows the conversation's DeepSeek account or API key; with other models, uses the API key first, then the signed-in account.
dict.billingApiKeyHint: Uses the API key from the Models page; set one first.
